{"code": "df_clean = df.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm'])

# Compute mean flipper length by species
mean_flipper_by_species = df_clean.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()

# Print each mean value explicitly
ad_weight = mean_flipper_by_species['Adelie']
chin_weight = mean_flipper_by_species['Chinstrap']
gentoo_weight = mean_flipper_by_species['Gentoo']

print(f"Mean flipper length of Adelie: {ad_weight}")
print(f"Mean flipper length of Chinstrap: {chin_weight}")
print(f"Mean flipper length of Gentoo: {gentoo_weight}")

# Find the species with the highest mean
highest_mean_species = mean_flipper_by_species.idxmax()
print(f"Species with highest mean flipper length: {highest_mean_species}")"}
